summary: The Data Engineer – AI Platforms builds and maintains the core data infrastructure for AI platforms, enabling efficient access, processing, and management of AI datasets.
responsibilities: Design and implement data pipelines for AI platform services
Ensure high-performance data storage and retrieval for AI workloads
Integrate structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources
Support AI feature engineering and model training workflows
Monitor data systems and ensure reliability and scalability

education: 4–8 years of experience in AI or ML-focused data engineering

skills_required.name: Expertise in Spark, Hadoop, or cloud-native data platforms
Knowledge of AI frameworks and large-scale ML datasets
Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and security
